items.title: DataNirnaya — Supply Chain Intelligence Platform
items.impact: Unified forecasting, inventory, supplier risk, and anomaly detection in one executive workspace.
items.summary: Full-stack platform fusing four ML services into a single decision surface for ops leaders. React + Vite + Tailwind + Recharts on the front; FastAPI microservices on the back.
highlights: Modular API abstraction so frontend renders identically on mock or live data
FastAPI microservices for Prophet/LightGBM forecasting, Isolation Forest anomaly, XGBoost supplier scoring
items.problem: Ops leaders run forecasting, supplier risk, and anomaly detection in four separate tools. No one trusts the picture.
items.approach: Single React workspace pulling from four FastAPI services through a unified API layer. Mock-data parity so the UI ships before the models do.
items.outcome: One workspace, four production ML services, one number leadership can defend on Monday.

items.title: Dynamic Pricing Engine — RL
items.impact: 12–18% revenue uplift over rule-based pricing in 12-month backtests.
items.summary: PPO agent adjusting prices on demand elasticity, competitor moves, and inventory. Custom Gym env with Prophet forecasts as state features.
highlights: Custom Gym env modeling elasticity, competitor moves, and stock position
Prophet forecasts injected as state features
12–18% lift vs rule-based baseline in backtests
items.problem: Rule-based pricing leaves margin on the table when demand and competitors move daily.
items.approach: PPO agent inside a custom Gym env. Prophet forecasts as state features. Reward function tuned for revenue under inventory constraints.
items.outcome: 12–18% revenue uplift over rule-based baseline across 12-month backtests.

items.title: Supply Chain Disruption Prediction
items.impact: 0.87 ROC-AUC; SHAP-driven analysis cut simulated disruption costs 15–20%.
items.summary: ML pipeline predicting supplier delays from lead-time, weather, port-congestion, and reliability features. SHAP surfaces the drivers procurement teams act on.
highlights: Multi-source feature engineering: lead-time, weather, port congestion, reliability history
SHAP-driven feature analysis reduced simulated disruption costs 15–20%
items.problem: Procurement gets blindsided by supplier delays. Static SLAs don't capture weather, port, or geopolitical signal.
items.approach: Gradient-boosted classifier on multi-source signals. SHAP attribution surfaces drivers procurement teams can actually act on.

items.title: Multi-Agent Business Strategy Simulator
items.impact: Compressed strategic planning cycles from weeks to minutes.
items.summary: Digital-twin simulation with five RL agents — Finance, Procurement, Sales, HR, Operations — negotiating tradeoffs instead of producing one black-box output.
highlights: Five RL agents (Finance, Procurement, Sales, HR, Ops) with their own reward functions
Kedro + MLflow for reproducible experiment tracking
items.problem: Strategic planning takes weeks because no one agrees on tradeoffs between finance, ops, and procurement.
items.approach: Five RL agents, one per function, each with its own reward. Mesa for simulation, RLlib for policy training, Kedro + MLflow for reproducibility.
items.outcome: Planning cycle from weeks to minutes. Tradeoffs become visible, negotiable, traceable.

items.title: Marketing Mix & Attribution Engine
items.impact: +25% ad-spend efficiency and +20% ROI across paid channels.
items.summary: Marketing Mix Model + multi-touch attribution layered with an A/B testing framework. Supported clients scaling to 300K+ MAU.
highlights: MMM disentangling spend → revenue across paid channels
A/B framework across 12+ campaigns; +82% organic traffic, +15% conversions
items.problem: Marketing leaders can't agree on which channel deserves the next dollar. Last-click lies.
items.approach: MMM for top-down attribution, multi-touch for journey credit, A/B framework for causal lifts. Three lenses, one budget.
items.outcome: +25% ad-spend efficiency, +20% ROI, clients scaling to 300K+ MAU.
